Calculate the entropy of a membership function represented as a probability vector

Source: R/calc_entropy.R
calc_entropy_tbl.Rd

Calculate the entropy of a membership function represented as a probability vector

Usage

calc_entropy_tbl(
  data,
  sources = NULL,
  targets = NULL,
  round = NULL,
  overall = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A membership_tbl object returned by membership_tbl().

sources

A character vector of source units to compare. If NULL (default), all source units are used.

targets

A character vector of target units to compare. If NULL (default), all target units are used.

round

A numeric value representing the round to consider. If NULL (default), all rounds are considered.

overall

A character string specifying the level at which to calculate overall entropy. Options are "by_source", "by_target", "by_interpreter", or "overall". If NULL (default), entropy is calculated for each source-interpreter combination.

Value

A data frame with interpreter-normalised, source-normalised and set-normalised entropy values. Defaults to source-interpreter entropy (averaged across interpreters for each source unit per round) if overall is NULL. If overall is specified, returns the mean entropy values based on the specified level.

Examples

data("TASVEG_xref")
TASVEG_memb <- TASVEG_xref |> dplyr::filter(VEGCODE %nin% c("AHF", "DOW", "MBS", "OAQ", "NAD")) |> membership_tbl(
  source_id = "VEGCODE",
  target_id = "efg",
  membership = "memb",
  interpreter = "interp"
)
  #TODO rm filter
TASVEG_memb  |> calc_entropy_tbl()
